title: Fraud Sanction Figures — Benefit Overpayment Accounts Quick Reference
content:
For Benefit Overpayment Accounts, the desk applies the following sanction figures by classification.

| Classification | Penalty weeks imposed | Years after the determination date within which penalty weeks are served | Look-back years for a repeat offense |
|---|---|---|---|
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Agency Error | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Employer Reporting Error | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Appeal Reversal | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Non-Fraud Overpayment — Claimant Error | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Fraud Overpayment — First Offense | 26 | 4 | 5 |
| Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense | 52 | 4 | 5 |

## Points of judgement

- **Penalty weeks** are fraud penalty weeks during which otherwise-payable weeks are denied.
- **The serving window** is the number of years after the fraud determination within which penalty weeks are served against weeks claimed; a figure of 0 means none.
- **The repeat-offense look-back** is the number of years before the new determination date within which a prior fraud determination makes the new one a repeat offense; a figure of 0 means the look-back does not apply.

## Reading the table

*Hypothetical:* a fraud determination for which the look-back finds no prior fraud determination is a Fraud Overpayment — First Offense and imposes 26 penalty weeks, served within 4 years after its determination date. Had the look-back of 5 years found a prior fraud determination, the classification would be Fraud Overpayment — Repeat Offense, with 52 penalty weeks.
